metadata.pdfUploadPolicy: PDFs must be uploaded using multipart/form-data; do not embed PDF as base64 in JSON
metadata.idPattern: caller-YYYYMMDD-###-req / caller-YYYYMMDD-###-res (caller-generated request and response IDs)

curlSamples.multipartWithDocument: curl -X POST "https://your-api.example.com/advanced/query" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -F "requestReferenceId=caller-20260324-001-req" -F "responseReferenceId=caller-20260324-001-res" -F "prompt=Summarize this medical paper with focus on study design, primary outcomes, adverse events, and limitations. Include cited pages." -F 'highlights=[{"word":"randomized controlled trial","pages":[2,4]},{"word":"adverse events","pages":[6,9]}]' -F "pdf=@/path/to/medical-paper.pdf;type=application/pdf" -F "documentName=medical-paper.pdf" -F "currentPage=6" -F "sessionId=session-42"
curlSamples.promptOnly: curl -X POST "https://your-api.example.com/advanced/query" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"requestReferenceId":"caller-20260324-201-req","responseReferenceId":"caller-20260324-201-res","prompt":"Give me a concise medical summary format I can use to evaluate clinical papers.","sessionId":"session-42" }'

request.prompt: Summarize this cardiology paper with focus on population, intervention, comparator, outcomes, and limitations.
request.note: Attach the PDF as multipart/form-data with field name 'pdf' when sending this request

response.answer: The paper describes a double-blind RCT in adults with heart failure and reports significant improvement in the primary endpoint, with modest increases in mild adverse events.

references.label: Trial design
references.quote: This study was double-blind and placebo-controlled.

references.label: Primary outcome
references.quote: The intervention group achieved a statistically significant reduction in the primary endpoint.

request.prompt: Summarize safety outcomes and adverse events from this oncology paper and cite the supporting pages.
request.note: Attach the PDF as multipart/form-data with field name 'pdf' when sending this request

response.answer: Grade 3 or higher adverse events were more frequent in the treatment arm, while treatment discontinuation rates were similar across groups.

references.label: Severe adverse events
references.quote: Grade 3 or higher adverse events occurred in 28% of intervention patients versus 19% in controls.

request.prompt: Summarize current best-practice criteria for reading a randomized clinical trial.
request.note: No document attached; do not include 'pdf' or 'documentName'

response.answer: When reviewing an RCT, prioritize population definition, randomization method, blinding, primary endpoint selection, effect size, confidence intervals, adverse-event profile, and external validity.
